show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Ashvin Chhabra – The Aspirational Investor (Capital Allocators, EP.260)
summary:
Ashvin joined
Euclidean in 2015 after spending time as CIO of the Institute for
Advanced Study and CIO of Merrill Lynch Wealth Management. He is
the author of The Aspirational Investor and is recognized
as one of the founders of goals-based wealth management. Our conversation covers into Ashvin’s upbringing and his path from
physics to investing.
